fields.description: Issue includes editorials and political commentary on local corruption, gambling, and an emerging “underworld” in Dade County; discussion of recall petitions targeting city officials (Sewell, Platt, and Knight); coverage of organized labor and claims about attempts to “sell” the labor vote; notes on the Chamber of Commerce’s new quarters; report that the Southern Bank & Trust Company is expected to reopen; and assorted local political notes, humor items, and advertisements tied to Miami and nearby communities during the 1928 election season and tourist period.
